channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Daily blueberries may have a surprising effect on mood
item.description: A small study found that eating blueberries every day led to greater reductions in depressive symptoms, suggesting surprising effects on mood.

item.title: Natural compound may protect the brain from excess salt
item.description: Excess salt may harm memory and social behavior beyond raising blood pressure. Japanese researchers discovered a natural compound that could protect the brain.

item.title: New findings challenge view of Japan's ancient volcanic disaster
item.description: A massive eruption struck Japan 7,300 years ago, but recent research indicates its effects on prehistoric people were much more complex than previously believed.

item.title: Psychedelic compound reduces aggression in fish, study finds
item.description: A substance from magic mushrooms unexpectedly calms aggressive fish, with researchers observing that low doses diminish their fighting behavior.
